selected_evidence.summary: Configuration and application hashes remained unchanged; final configuration and output remained `region=west` and `report=weekly`.
A reversible missing-application test produced launcher exit status 2 before and after restart; the application was restored and healthy.
CentOS Stream 10 and kernel `6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64` were unchanged across the repair and reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID `5b620f5a-2111-4f37-b111-4cdf414707cf` was captured, the native reboot was acknowledged, node1 returned with boot ID `517946a9-6e1c-4be8-ba4f-5885173152db`, and system/application health and data were verified.
